card.title: Basically Finished
card.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cupboard's finished. I've left the shelves loose so you can choose the heights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's complete as an adjustable kit. Position everything around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you to install it. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fasten one shelf at your chosen height. A finished sample, so you can approve the rest.

mechanism: A calls unfinished installation an adjustable kit and then a completed sample to preserve the language of completion.
confusable: Unlike promising to finish later, A must describe the current partial state as deliberately complete in some form.
comparison: D41-a relabels one installed shelf as a sample; D41-b relabels a title page plus one word as a decision edition.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
